items.title: Supreme Court strikes down Trump's tariffs in major rebuke
items.title_zh: 美國最高法院駁回特朗普關稅政策
items.desc: The U.S. Supreme Court ruled 6-3 that President Trump exceeded his authority in imposing sweeping tariffs under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act, dealing a major blow to his signature economic policy.
items.desc_zh: 美國最高法院以6比3裁定，特朗普總統在國際緊急經濟權力法下實施全面關稅超越了其權限，這對其核心經濟政策是重大打擊。

items.title: Ukraine and Russia hold peace talks in Geneva
items.title_zh: 烏克蘭與俄羅斯在日內瓦舉行和平談判
items.desc: U.S.-mediated peace talks between Ukraine and Russia entered a second day in Geneva, with President Trump pressing Kyiv to act fast to reach a deal. Ukraine expressed dissatisfaction with the outcome while Washington reported 'meaningful progress'.
items.desc_zh: 美國斡旋的烏俄和平談判在日內瓦進入第二天，特朗普總統施壓基輔儘快達成協議。烏克蘭對結果表示不滿，而華盛頓稱取得了'有意義的進展'。

items.title: North Korea's Kim lauds economy at party congress
items.title_zh: 金正恩在黨代會上讚揚朝鮮經濟
items.desc: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un praised his nation's improving economy and regional standing at the Workers' Party congress. Analysts say he may position his daughter as potential successor during this important political gathering.
items.desc_zh: 朝鮮領導人金正恩在勞動黨代表大會上讚揚國家經濟改善和區域地位提升。分析師稱他可能在此重要政治會議上為其女兒確立潛在繼承人地位。

items.title: World Food Programme warns Somalia aid could halt by April
items.title_zh: 世界糧食計劃署警告索馬里援助可能在4月停止
items.desc: The U.N. World Food Programme warned that life-saving food and nutrition assistance in Somalia could grind to a halt by April unless new funding is secured, putting millions at risk of worsening hunger.
items.desc_zh: 聯合國世界糧食計劃署警告，除非獲得新資金，否則索馬里的救生糧食和營養援助可能在4月停止，數百萬人將面臨飢餓加劇的風險。

items.title: Trump launches Board of Peace despite bigger countries steering clear
items.title_zh: 特朗普成立和平委員會 大國卻紛紛迴避
items.desc: President Trump established a Board of Peace to upend traditional diplomatic channels, even as larger nations avoid participation. Recovery costs are estimated at $53 billion according to a World Bank report.
items.desc_zh: 特朗普總統成立和平委員會以顛覆傳統外交渠道，但大國紛紛避免參與。據世界銀行報告，重建成本估計達530億美元。

items.title: IMF calls for China to rebalance toward consumption
items.title_zh: IMF呼籲中國經濟向消費轉型
items.desc: The IMF released its annual report on China, urging authorities to rebalance the economy toward consumption as the investment and export-led growth model now faces challenges. Growth forecast for 2026 is 4.5%.
items.desc_zh: 國際貨幣基金組織發布年度中國報告，敦促當局將經濟轉向消費導向，因投資和出口導向的增長模式現正面臨挑戰。2026年增長預測為4.5%。

items.title: China sees opportunity to turn Trump tariffs to its advantage
items.title_zh: 中國看到將特朗普關稅轉為優勢的機會
items.desc: China sees an opening to reshape global trade in ways that would insulate its $19 trillion economy from U.S. pressure far into the future, capitalizing on the changing trade landscape.
items.desc_zh: 中國看到重塑全球貿易的機會，以使其19萬億美元的經濟遠離美國壓力，利用不斷變化的貿易格局。

items.title: No easy way out of China's slowdown
items.title_zh: 中國經濟放緩難有出路
items.desc: China has grown steadily, but its structural slowdown is coming at a time when it is contending with the aftermath of a property bust and heightened trade tensions. These challenges are likely to be significant factors in China's economic future.
items.desc_zh: 中國經濟穩步增長，但結構性放緩正值其應對房地產泡沫後果和貿易緊張局勢加劇之際。這些挑戰可能成為中國經濟未來的重要因素。

items.title: IMF says China's economic model is hurting global economy
items.title_zh: IMF稱中國經濟模式損害全球經濟
items.desc: The IMF executive board called for a major shift in China's policy framework, urging comprehensive measures combining macroeconomic stimulus with structural reforms to address overcapacity and deflationary pressures.
items.desc_zh: IMF執行董事會呼籲中國政策框架重大轉變，敦促採取綜合措施，結合宏觀經濟刺激與結構性改革，以解決產能過剩和通縮壓力。

items.title: ByteDance Seedance 2.0 AI video tool spooks Hollywood
items.title_zh: 字節跳動Seedance 2.0 AI視頻工具震驚好萊塢
items.desc: ByteDance's new AI video generation tool Seedance 2.0 has gone viral, creating cinematic videos that alarmed Hollywood studios. Paramount and Disney sent cease-and-desist letters accusing the company of IP infringement.
items.desc_zh: 字節跳動的新AI視頻生成工具Seedance 2.0走紅，創建的電影級視頻讓好萊塢工作室震驚。派拉蒙和迪士尼發出停止令，指控該公司侵犯知識產權。

items.title: Hong Kong property market forecast to rebound in 2026
items.title_zh: 香港樓市預計2026年反彈
items.desc: Morgan Stanley expects Hong Kong home prices to grow more than 10% in 2026, after rising 5% in 2025. Land sale revenue is forecast to reach HK$12-15 billion, a 60% year-on-year increase.
items.desc_zh: 摩根士丹利預計香港樓價2026年將增長超過10%，2025年上漲5%。土地銷售收入預計達120-150億港元，同比增長60%。

items.title: Mainland buyers reshape Hong Kong property market
items.title_zh: 內地買家重塑香港樓市格局
items.desc: After Lunar New Year, Hong Kong's property market is seeing a 'small spring' recovery. Mainland buyers are becoming a key driving force, significantly changing market structure with their purchasing power.
items.desc_zh: 農曆新年後，香港樓市正迎來「小陽春」復甦。內地買家正成為關鍵推動力，其購買力顯著改變市場結構。

items.title: Hang Seng Index sees volatility amid global market shifts
items.title_zh: 恒生指數在全球市場變化中波動
items.desc: Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index has been experiencing volatility as global markets react to changing trade policies and economic data. Technology stocks have shown mixed performance.
items.desc_zh: 隨著全球市場對不斷變化的貿易政策和經濟數據作出反應，香港恒生指數一直波動。科技股表現參差不齊。

items.title: Hong Kong office market leads recovery after six-year correction
items.title_zh: 香港寫字樓市場在六年調整後帶領復甦
items.desc: JLL expects capital values in the mass residential segment to rise by about 5% in 2026, while luxury residential values will remain broadly flat. Young housing estates will enjoy higher upside.
items.desc_zh: 仲量聯行預計2026年大眾住宅資本價值將上漲約5%，而豪華住宅價值將保持大致平穩。新屋苑將享有更高的上升空間。

items.title: Hong Kong budget deficit expected at HK$67 billion for 2025-26
items.title_zh: 香港2025-26年度財政赤字預計為670億港元
items.desc: Hong Kong's Financial Secretary forecast a deficit of HK$67 billion for fiscal year 2025-26, with fiscal reserves decreasing to HK$580.3 billion. The budget focuses on innovation and technology development.
items.desc_zh: 香港財政司司長預測2025-26財政年度赤字為670億港元，財政儲備將下降至5803億港元。預算重點關注創新和科技發展。

items.title: GDS Holdings - Leading Data Center Operator in China
items.title_zh: 萬國數據 - 中國領先數據中心運營商
items.desc: GDS Holdings (NASDAQ: GDS, HKEX: 9698) is China's leading data center developer and operator. Listed on Nasdaq in 2016 and Hong Kong Stock Exchange in 2020, GDS operates high-performance data centers serving cloud service providers and large enterprises.
items.desc_zh: 萬國數據（納斯達克：GDS，港交所：9698）是中國領先的數據中心開發商和運營商。於2016年在納斯達克上市，2020年在香港交易所上市，萬國數據運營高性能數據中心，為雲服務提供商和大型企業服務。

items.title: Data center market to reach $430.18 billion in 2026
items.title_zh: 數據中心市場2026年將達到4301.8億美元
items.desc: The global data center market is expected to reach $430.18 billion in 2026, driven by rising adoption of cloud computing and AI workloads. Market is projected to reach $1.1 trillion by 2035.
items.desc_zh: 全球數據中心市場預計2026年將達到4301.8億美元，由雲計算和AI工作負載需求上升推動。市場預計到2035年將達到1.1萬億美元。

items.title: Roughly 100 GW of new data center capacity expected by 2030
items.title_zh: 到2030年預計新增約100吉瓦數據中心容量
items.desc: JLL anticipates roughly 100 GW of new data center capacity coming online between 2026 and 2030, equating to $1.2 trillion in real estate asset value creation. This growth is driven by AI and cloud computing demand.
items.desc_zh: 仲量聯行預計2026年至2030年間將有約100吉瓦新數據中心容量上線，相當於1.2萬億美元的房地產資產價值創造。這一增長由AI和雲計算需求推動。

items.title: GDS Wealth Management increases Microsoft holdings
items.title_zh: GDS Wealth Management增持微軟股份
items.desc: GDS Wealth Management raised its holdings in Microsoft Corporation by 5.7% in Q3, according to its most recent 13F filing. The firm now owns 58,512 shares valued at approximately $30.31 million.
items.desc_zh: 根據最新13F申報，GDS Wealth Management第三季度將其微軟持股增加了5.7%。該公司現持有58,512股，價值約3031萬美元。

items.title: Aberdeen Group reduces position in GDS Holdings
items.title_zh: Aberdeen Group減持萬國數據股份
items.desc: Aberdeen Group plc trimmed its holdings in GDS Holdings by 15.9% during Q3, according to its most recent 13F filing with the SEC. The move reflects institutional repositioning in the data center sector.
items.desc_zh: 根據向SEC提交的最新13F申報，Aberdeen Group plc在第三季度將其萬國數據持股減少了15.9%。此舉反映了機構對數據中心板塊的重新調整。

items.title: Researchers Reveal Six New OpenClaw Vulnerabilities
items.title_zh: 研究人員發現六個新的OpenClaw漏洞
items.desc: OpenClaw has patched six new vulnerabilities including SSRF, missing authentication and path traversal bugs. The flaws range from moderate to high severity, with some having public exploit code available.
items.desc_zh: OpenClaw已修補六個新漏洞，包括SSRF、缺失認證和路徑遍歷錯誤。這些漏洞從中等到高嚴重性，部分已有公開利用代碼。

items.title: AI anxiety could fuel new workers' movement
items.title_zh: AI焦慮可能催生新的工人運動
items.desc: The Guardian's Reworked series explores how AI anxiety is dissolving class divisions between blue-collar and white-collar workers, potentially catalyzing a new workers' movement for dignity and power in the age of automation.
items.desc_zh: 衛報的Reworked系列探討AI焦慮如何消除藍領和白領工人之間的階級分歧，可能催生自動化時代爭取尊嚴和權力的新工人運動。

items.title: Cline CLI supply chain attack installed OpenClaw on developer systems
items.title_zh: Cline CLI供應鏈攻擊在開發者系統上安裝OpenClaw
items.desc: A supply chain attack on Cline CLI 2.3.0 stealthily installed OpenClaw on developer systems. The incident highlights growing security concerns around AI agent deployment in enterprise environments.
items.desc_zh: 對Cline CLI 2.3.0的供應鏈攻擊偷偷在開發者系統上安裝了OpenClaw。這一事件凸顯了企業環境中AI代理部署的安全擔憂日益增加。

items.title: Researchers find 40,000+ exposed OpenClaw instances
items.title_zh: 研究人員發現超過4萬個暴露的OpenClaw實例
items.desc: Security researchers discovered over 40,000 misconfigured OpenClaw instances exposed to the public internet, potentially enabling threat actors to gain full access to sensitive corporate systems.
items.desc_zh: 安全研究人員發現超過4萬個配置錯誤的OpenClaw實例暴露在公共互聯網上，可能使威脅行為者獲得對敏感企業系統的完全訪問權限。

items.title: AI spending forecast to reach $2.5 trillion in 2026
items.title_zh: AI支出預計2026年將達到2.5萬億美元
items.desc: According to Gartner, AI spending is forecast to skyrocket to $2.5 trillion in 2026, driven by massive global build-out of data centres and services. This represents one of history's largest technology investments.
items.desc_zh: 據Gartner稱，受全球數據中心和服務大規模建設推動，AI支出預計2026年將飆升至2.5萬億美元。這代表著有史以來最大的技術投資之一。

items.title: Microsoft publishes guide on running OpenClaw safely
items.title_zh: 微軟發布安全運行OpenClaw指南
items.desc: Microsoft's security team published a comprehensive guide on safely deploying OpenClaw, addressing identity management, isolation, and runtime risks. The guide notes OpenClaw has limited built-in security controls.
items.desc_zh: 微軟安全團隊發布了安全部署OpenClaw的綜合指南，涉及身份管理、隔離和運行時風險。該指南指出OpenClaw的內置安全控制有限。

items.title: OpenAI to establish first office in India
items.title_zh: OpenAI將在印度設立首個辦事處
items.desc: OpenAI will set up its first office in India this year. Sam Altman told a U.S. congressional committee that the future of AI is contested between 'American-led, democratic' models and authoritarian alternatives.
items.desc_zh: OpenAI今年將在印度設立首個辦事處。Sam Altman告訴美國國會委員會，AI的未來正在「美國領導的民主」模式與威權替代方案之間展開競爭。
